source_context.item_title: The aft deck is designed to support a wide range of activities and adapt to your needs. Optional foldable activity platforms make watersports, swimming, social gatherings, or practical gear loading easier, while expanding the deck and improving water access.

images.hero_reason: Exterior MY2026 del modelo, horizontal 11811x7874; Tag DAM del modelo (ax38, ax38xc, axopar, finland, my26, out).

source_context.item_title: The reimagined bow creates a genuine social space that adapts to different uses. Owners can choose between standard forward-facing seating or upgrade to a U-sofa with a table that converts into a sunbed, or opt for a fixed extended sun lounge.

images.title: Axopar 38 XC Cross Cabin_A7501056
images.scope_evidence: Tag DAM del modelo (ax38, ax38xc, axopar, ins, my26, turkey).

source_context.item_title: The helm offers clear visibility and intuitive ergonomics for confident control. Two rotating seats, or the Driver's Sofa, let the driver and co-driver face the social area, creating a natural connection between driving and interaction onboard.

images.title: Axopar 38 XC Cross Cabin_A7502905
images.scope_evidence: Tag DAM del modelo (ax38, ax38xc, axopar, ins, lifestyle, my26).

source_context.item_title: The wheelhouse is a space for relaxing and socializing. Two sofas and a fixed table come standard, and options like a U-sofa or a reversible driver’s sofa create a dining area or lounge. Sliding doors, an aft window, and a canvas roof bring in fresh air.

images.title: Axopar 38 XC Cross Cabin_099A6627
images.scope_evidence: Tag DAM del modelo (ax38, ax38xc, axopar, finland, ins, my26).

source_context.item_title: The front cabin is bright and spacious with higher headroom, skylights, and gullwing doors. The bed converts to a lounge, and a new optional kitchen module adds storage and appliance space. Optional features include an enclosed toilet with a shower and warm water.
